biggest_catch: Hard 24-hour deadline - you must fund your account within 24 hours of first viewing the dashboard, or the free-stock reward expires permanently.
catches: Must fund the account within 24 hours of first viewing the Portfolio/Dashboard page after approval; unclaimed reward expires and cannot be recovered
Reward is either A$10 of buying power or a free US stock (randomly Nike, Dropbox, GoPro, or a mystery stock) - the free stock's value varies and is not stated in advance
One claim per person; not eligible for multiple accounts; non-individual accounts (SMSF, company, minor) excluded from Wall St funding rewards
Available in Stake's AU/NZ/UK operating regions; AU rewards page referenced
Capital at risk - investing can lose money; free stock has capital-gains-tax implications noted in terms
